records.text: Steve Deace said Tyler Robinson made three confessions: one to his parents, one to his roommate, and one on Discord.
records.speaker: Steve Deace

appearances.snippet: So we have three confessions here, one to his parents, one to his roommate, and one on Discord.

verification.notes: Current official and hearing records document three alleged admissions: an implication or confession to family, statements to roommate Lance Twiggs, and a Discord message saying it was him. This verifies Deace’s description of reported confessions, not Robinson’s guilt; Robinson remains accused and has not entered a plea.
